title: Georges St-Pierre's CE5 sessions bring orbs

tellings.quote: They see orbs in the sky. I was just on the phone with um UFC fighter George St. Pierre and he was like, "I've been doing this and they they show up a lot."

plain: Georges St-Pierre, a famous fighter from the UFC, the biggest professional mixed martial arts league, says that when he holds CE5 sessions, group meditations meant to invite UFOs to appear, glowing orbs show up in the sky "a lot." Michels passes this on from a phone call he had with St-Pierre, as part of a point about how many people now report such sightings.
